rationale: C12 is the strongest plausible template because it concerns the same Pullman Company, the same employee organization, and the same emergency-board mechanism, while sharing nearly the entire sequence and wording of the child. The child materially adapts that directive by adding the Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul & Pacific Railroad Company and changing the dispute references from singular to plural. C23 and C04 closely match the Kennedy-era phrasing, with C23 especially supplying the plural grammatical pattern, but neither shares the child’s distinctive Pullman/union pairing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: disputes exist between the Pullman Company and the Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul & Pacific Railroad Company, carriers, and certain of their employees represented by the Order of Railway Conductors and Brakemen
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a dispute exists between The Pullman Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Order of Railway Conductors and Brakemen
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves C12’s distinctive carrier and labor-organization pairing while adding a second carrier and pluralizing the construction.

shared_material.child_excerpt: these disputes have not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.explanation: The same legal predicate is retained with only singular-to-plural adaptation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to these disputes within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The reporting duty, recipient, subject, and thirty-day deadline are materially identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President no change, except by agreement, shali be made by the Pullman Company and the Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul & Pacific Railroad Company, or by their employees, in the conditions out of which these disputes arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by The Pullman Company, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The child carries forward C12’s statutory standstill machinery and substitutes an expanded carrier group and plural dispute references.
